comparison.objective: Stand a calibration board in its holder with its face oriented toward a camera.
comparison.physical_skill: Board grasping, slot/holder alignment, insertion, and orientation versus hex-bit seating, screw torque, collar adjustment, and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Board stably seated and camera-facing versus locked damper adjustment verified across two dynamic cycles.
comparison.reason: Holder insertion is a meaningful manipulation skill, but there is no adjustment, locking, or measured-response iteration. The record has no spec versions or numeric seating tolerances.
